note: Both sets repeat the 20% glazing fact many times, but Set A introduces more defects: it misbinds the 20% condition to 'HARVEST SCREEN' instead of HARVEST HOME, calls the actuator type 'shape memory alloy (SMA), Flexinol' (the actuator is a Nitinol wire; Flexinol is only a trade name for Nitinol wire), splices a fabricated quote ('Harvest Shade Screens imbued a more novel, Through the design...'), and reports the 20% as an 'area'. Set B keeps the same core facts (Nitinol wire actuator, latent solar energy, no additional energy, rotational louver closure, Flexinol/SMA/Nitinol relationships) with only one comparable misbinding (composition percentage of HARVEST SCREEN) plus a truncated quote, and adds a supported louver-orientation claim.
